text:
ashwin: Quick take 1 0  We need a pattern for surfacing SLO alert thresholds in the Console that ties into routing/quotas. Two asks: make defaults sensible for new tenants, and allow ops to do per-tenant 'soft' overrides without changing core SLO config. Thoughts?

tess: Agree. Defaults should be conservative (fewer noisy alerts) but also explain tradeoffs. UX idea: SLO card -> "Notify & Routing" tab with a small "quiet mode" toggle and an "override" button that creates a policy scoped to the tenant.

luisa: Can we reuse existing quota-aware routing? e.g., if tenant hits quota burn-rate, automatically apply backoff to non-critical routes and favor cached/quantized model variants. Important: make this visible on the SLO timeline.

keith: Implementation note: routing decisions must be deterministic and auditable. Emit trace event `slo_notify_route` with tags {tenant, route, trigger, override_id}. Store last 7 days for investigation.

samir: API sketch for override (JSON): ```json
{"tenant_id":"T-123","override_id":"ov-789","scope":"slo","notify_threshold_pct":0.85,"apply_mode":"soft","route_policy":"quota_backoff","expires_at":"2024-08-15T00:00:00Z"}
```

ashwin: UX: "soft" should mean we suppress noisy alerts and lower fanout for 24h unless manually escalated. Console should show expected signal reduction (est. alerts/day) and estimated cost delta. Add small CTA: Preview impact.

luisa: Telemetry needs: `slo.notify.sampled_alerts` (sampled payloads), `slo.notify.fanout_size`, and `routing.quota_backoff.count`. Each should include `override_id` when present. Sampling rate must be configurable per-tenant.

keith: Alert rule proposal: Primary console alert when actual alerts/day > expected_by_model * 2 for 1h despite soft override. If triggered, surface a "Tenant noisy" badge and open a quick action to escalate or suspend notifications.

tess: Rollout plan: Start with internal tenants + 10 enterprise customers as an opt-in alpha. Expose per-tenant toggle in Console. Also run a canary where overrides are simulated (preview only) for 200 tenants to validate estimation model.

samir: Estimation model note: use historical alerts/week, recent error_budget_use_rate, and quota burn velocity. Output a CI with upper/lower bounds: expected_alerts/day +/- 95% CI. We should show that in preview.

ashwin: Side question: should override objects be editable or immutable? I'd prefer immutable (create new override to change) so rollbacks are easier to reason about.

luisa: Immutable is safer. Add `parent_override_id` field for bookkeeping. Console UI can show history.

keith: Security: limit who can create tenant-level overrides (ops and account owners). Add audit log entry: `override.create` with actor and trace.

tess: UX nit: when creating override, show a compact diff of the SLO card before/after and a small risk meter (low/medium/high) based on estimation model.

samir: For the backend, we'll need an enforcement hook in notify pipeline to check `override_apply_mode` and `override_expiry`. Pseudocode: ```python
if override and not expired:
  if override.apply_mode == 'soft':
    reduce_fanout(override.policy)
  elif override.apply_mode == 'force':
    force_route(override.route_policy)
```

ashwin: Can we also add an auto-expire guard: any override older than 30d gets a console banner recommending review?

luisa: yes. And a nightly job to mark stale overrides `stale=true` and notify ops.

keith: One more: include a safety alert rule: if after an override, `slo.quality.delta > 0.03` sustained > 30m => auto-revert override and page oncall. Tag the revert action in audit log.

tess: :thumbsup: that rollback should be visible in console with reason and link to sampled responses to inspect.

rollout-bot: rollout-bot: created task PF-4023 (Console override UI) and scheduled staging canary for 2024-07-12 (job: canary-221).

ashwin: I'll wire up RFC and include API proto changes + suggested telemetry. Will post by EOD. Followups: - wire audit logs to SSO actor names, - ensure sampling rate config is per-tenant and org-wide limits, - add runbook snippet for manual revert.

(tl;dr: Add tenant-scoped SLO notify overrides (soft/force), Console preview with estimated alerts/cost, telemetry tags (override_id), immutable overrides, and safety rollback alert)
